verdict.rationale: Jules's core interaction model is natural-language: users submit tasks/messages describing work, it plans and executes, and messages can also be sent via issue labels or API calls (jules-docs-2, jules-docs-4, jules-docs-12). Community reports confirm real-world use via prompts/messages (jules-comm-14, jules-comm-16). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of command syntax/flexibility and independent benchmarking of NL understanding quality beyond anecdotal reports.
